meta.amfiCutoffNote: AMFI Jan 2026 ref: small/micro = below ~Rs 34,700 cr (rank 251+). All five sit below the mid-cap floor.

thesis.core: Among Asia's largest industrial gearbox makers plus material-handling equipment; debt-free with ~25% ROCE, riding multi-sector capex (power, cement, steel, mining, defence) and a shift to higher-margin after-market.
thesis.catalysts: Capex up-cycle order inflows, defence/marine gear approvals, margin expansion from mix, export growth.
thesis.whatMustGoRight: Order inflows stay strong through the capex cycle and margins hold; no large value-destructive acquisition.
thesis.risks: Capex cyclicality, raw-material (steel) costs, execution; valuation re-rating risk after a strong multi-year run.
thesis.invalidation: Two quarters of order-inflow decline, OPM contraction >300bps, ROCE below 18%, any promoter pledge, or a decisive close below the 200-DMA.

sources.label: Screener.in / ValueResearch — ELECON
sources.note: CMP 510, mcap 11449 cr, ROCE 24.9%, debt-free, promoter 59.3%

thesis.core: India's largest transmission-tower maker (top-10 globally) levered to a once-in-a-decade power T&D / grid capex super-cycle; engineering products + polymer (pipes) diversification, no promoter pledge.
thesis.catalysts: Record grid-capex ordering (PGCIL/state utilities), export wins, polymer-pipe scale-up; PAT +63% in Q4 FY26.
thesis.whatMustGoRight: T&D capex ordering sustains and thin EPC margins improve with operating leverage; working capital stays controlled.
thesis.risks: Low net margins (~4%), commodity/working-capital intensity, competitive EPC bidding, debt at ~0.5x.
thesis.invalidation: Order-book/inflow stalling, OCF turning negative, debt/equity above 1.0, any promoter pledge, or surveillance entry.

sources.label: Screener.in — SKIPPER
sources.note: CMP 572.70, mcap 6443 cr, ROIC 31%, ROE 13.7%, PAT +63% Q4, promoter 66.5%

sources.label: Trendlyne / ScanX — SKIPPER surveillance & pledge
sources.note: no ASM/GSM; promoters declared no encumbrance

thesis.core: Fast-scaling B2B jewellery manufacturer riding the formalisation of India's ~$145bn jewellery market; ROCE ~30%, no promoter pledge, and a promoter zero-salary (dividend-linked) model — with sales up ~77% YoY.
thesis.catalysts: New large-retailer client additions, capacity ramp to ~900 kg/month by FY27, net-debt reduction, organised-sector share gains.
thesis.whatMustGoRight: Growth converts to cash as working capital normalises and net debt falls per guidance; client concentration stays manageable.
thesis.risks: Thin B2B margins, high working-capital/debt (D/E ~0.9), gold-price-inflated growth optics, customer concentration.
thesis.invalidation: Net debt rising instead of falling, OCF persistently weak, loss of an anchor customer, or pledge appearing.

sources.label: Screener.in / Tickertape — SKYGOLD
sources.note: CMP 513.05, mcap 8184 cr, ROCE 30%, PE 29.7, sales +77% YoY, 52wk 246-590

sources.label: Whalesbook / Investywise — SKYGOLD debt & governance
sources.note: no pledge; D/E 0.9x (down from 3.7x); zero-salary promoter model

thesis.core: World's #2 composite (Type-IV) cylinder maker and India's largest plastic-drum/IBC producer; value-added composites (CNG/hydrogen/LPG) reshaping the mix toward higher margins and ROCE, while debt and working capital trend down.
thesis.catalysts: Composite-cylinder export/order wins (CNG cascades, hydrogen, LPG conversions), margin/ROCE uplift, debt reduction; trades cheap (~22x).
thesis.whatMustGoRight: Value-added share keeps rising so ROCE moves toward high-teens/20s, and the established (slow-grower) base re-rates.
thesis.risks: Polymer/commodity cycle, slower legacy growth, capital intensity; weak recent price trend (below 50- & 200-DMA).
thesis.invalidation: ROCE stalling below 14%, value-added mix not improving, debt rising, or working capital deteriorating.

sources.label: Screener.in / Morningstar — TIMETECHNO
sources.note: CMP 167, ~45.4 cr shares (~7,580 cr mcap), ROCE 15%, D/E 0.25, debt/EBITDA 0.82

thesis.core: Cyient-backed EMS player levered to a sector growing ~30% CAGR (FY25-28); record order book (book-to-bill ~1.46) and a management roadmap to lift ROCE from ~10% to ~25% — a classic emerging-multibagger turnaround, highest risk/reward of the five.
thesis.catalysts: Order execution ramp, A&D + non-A&D diversification, margin/ROCE improvement, new plant utilisation.
thesis.whatMustGoRight: ROCE actually climbs toward the mid-teens then 25% as the order book converts and working capital is funded without dilution.
thesis.risks: Low current returns (ROCE ~10%, ROE ~7.5%), rich valuation (P/E ~55), rising working capital, execution and customer concentration.
thesis.invalidation: ROCE failing to improve over 4-6 quarters, book-to-bill below 1.0, working capital ballooning, or an equity raise at a poor price.
